items.title: AWS becomes first CSP to complete the Cloud High profile assessment with 172 services and features in scope
items.summary: We continue to expand the scope of our assurance programs at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and are pleased to announce the successful completion of our first ever Cloud High (PBHH) security assessment with 172 assessed services and features. Completion of this assessment, effective September 18, 2026, makes AWS the first cloud service provider (CSP) in […]
